skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage. Clothes Leizi wore at a game expo. She plays a mysterious wandering scholar with a magical companion. Her dedication was praiseworthy, and she brought a true ending to the story.
skins.quote: When 'Destiny Quest' launched, the wandering scholar watched over the ruins, welcoming the hero to the start of their rough-and-tumble journey. Leizi doubted her motives, broke down her words, searched all over for her secrets, before finally unlocking the hidden level after the end of the game.
